sharedEffect: Once while face-up on the field, during damage calculation in your opponent's turn, if this card is being attacked (Quick Effect): You can target the attacking monster; make that target's ATK 0 during damage calculation only.

policy.window: Opponent's turn, Damage Step, Damage Calculation response window
policy.target: The attacking monster that is targeting the source component
policy.modifier: ATK becomes 0 for this damage calculation only
policy.usage: Once per explicit face-up-instance token; token must change after face-down/up or leave/re-enter
policy.controller: Current team Monster Zone containing the component, not physical UID owner

attacking target only; no direct attack
opponent turn and both face-up combatants

certification.reason: The adapter is not registered in the shared combat resolver, effect registry, manifest or allowlist. No certification is claimed.

limitations: The adapter requires a caller-supplied face-up-instance token; current cardLifetimes epoch increments on zone changes but not face-down/face-up transitions.
